import sys,json,tempfile,time,queue,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from semantic_lsp import LspProcess,MeasurementError
class Trace(LspProcess):
 def __init__(self,*args):self.raw=[];super().__init__(*args)
 def _dispatch(self,body,received_ns):self.raw.append(json.loads(body));return super()._dispatch(body,received_ns)
 def expected_error(self,method,params):
  request_id,_=self.send_request(self.prepare_request(method,params));deadline=time.monotonic()+30
  while True:
   body,received_ns=self.messages.get(timeout=max(0.01,deadline-time.monotonic()))
   if isinstance(body,Exception) or body is None:raise MeasurementError('transport ended during expected error')
   message=json.loads(body)
   if message.get('id')==request_id:
    self.raw.append(message);del self.pending[request_id]
    assert 'error' in message,message
    return message
   self._dispatch(body,received_ns)
 def current_diagnostics(self,uri,version):
  deadline=time.monotonic()+30
  while self.diagnostics.get(uri,{}).get('version')!=version:self._receive(deadline)
  return self.diagnostics[uri]
def offset(text,position):
 lines=text.splitlines(keepends=True);line=position['line'];units=position['character']
 return sum(map(len,lines[:line]))+len(lines[line].encode('utf-16-le')[:units*2].decode('utf-16-le'))
def workspace_edits(edit,uri,version):
 if 'documentChanges' in edit:
  changes=edit['documentChanges'];assert len(changes)==1,edit
  change=changes[0];assert change['textDocument']=={'uri':uri,'version':version},change
  return change['edits']
 assert set(edit)=={'changes'} and set(edit['changes'])=={uri},edit
 return edit['changes'][uri]
def apply_edit(text,edit,uri,version):
 spans=[(offset(text,e['range']['start']),offset(text,e['range']['end']),e['newText']) for e in workspace_edits(edit,uri,version)]
 for start,end,replacement in sorted(spans,reverse=True):text=text[:start]+replacement+text[end:]
 return text

report={'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'compiler':'/tmp/semantic-review-native/bend/bin/bend','cases':[]}

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='completion-kind-first-') as temporary:
 workspace=Path(temporary);module=workspace/'candidates.bend';root=workspace/'main.bend'

 text='def main() -> U32:\n  C';root.write_text(text);uri=root.as_uri();client=Trace(binary,workspace)
 try:
  client.initialize()
  client.notify('textDocument/didOpen',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri,'languageId':'bend','version':1,'text':text}})
  client.request('workspace/symbol',{'query':'main'})
  module.write_text('type T is Data:\n  C{}\ndef C() -> U32:\n  0\n')
  client.notify('workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles',{'changes':[{'uri':module.as_uri(),'type':1}]})
  response=client.request('textDocument/completion',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri},'position':{'line':1,'character':3}})[0]
  items=response['items'] if isinstance(response,dict) else response
  candidates=[item for item in items if item['label']=='C' and item.get('kind')==3 and any('candidates.bend' in edit['newText'] for edit in item.get('additionalTextEdits',[]))]
  assert len(candidates)==1,items
  selected=candidates[0];primary=selected['textEdit'];assert 'range' in primary,selected
  edits=selected['additionalTextEdits']+[primary]
  spans=[(offset(text,edit['range']['start']),offset(text,edit['range']['end']),edit['newText']) for edit in edits]
  for start,end,replacement in sorted(spans,reverse=True):text=text[:start]+replacement+text[end:]
  client.notify('textDocument/didChange',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri,'version':2},'contentChanges':[{'text':text}]})
  at=text.rfind('C');before=text[:at];position={'line':before.count('\n'),'character':len(before.rsplit('\n',1)[-1].encode('utf-16-le'))//2}
  definition=client.request('textDocument/definition',{'textDocument':{'uri':uri},'position':position})[0]
  assert definition=={'uri':module.as_uri(),'range':{'start':{'line':2,'character':4},'end':{'line':2,'character':5}}},definition
  report.update(selected_completion=selected,applied_source=text,definition_after_acceptance=definition)
 except BaseException:
  report.update(wire=client.raw,stderr=client.stderr_tail());print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False),file=sys.stderr);raise
 finally:
  client.finish();report.update(exit=client.process.returncode,wire=client.raw)
 assert report['exit']==0,report
